init_resolvers: initialize OmegaConf resolvers self_instantiate and ref before calling hydra.main
ref_config_path: reference an existing OmegaConf config path and retrieve its value including self-instantiated fields
self_instantiate_config: automatically instantiate a config node with _target_ and arguments using self_instantiate resolver
register_custom_resolvers: register custom OmegaConf resolvers for config interpolation and object instantiation
instantiate_config_object: instantiate a Python object from OmegaConf config node with _target_, _args_, and keyword arguments
